strings: Something is really wrong, r_c0 worriedly fusses over m_c as {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} escapism seems to blend into {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} reality.
m_c seems to be struggling to distinguish where {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} dream ends and reality begins to the distress of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates.
While {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates watch over {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, m_c's eyes track and follow in distress things that only {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can seem to see.
m_c shivers in their den, the shadows on the walls and out of the corner of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes making monsters.

All dreams have risk of becoming nightmares, and these daydreams are no different as sleeplessness and escapism don't mix well. m_c shivers as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/struggle/struggles} to find where reality actually is.
m_c has the horrible realisation that this isn't a daydream anymore.
